record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: India Code lists the Environment (Protection) Act as Act No. 29 of 1986 and dates it 23 May 1986, establishing the enactment year. The Act’s footnote separately gives 19 November 1986 as its commencement date, so enactment and commencement should not be conflated.
